decisions.decision: Use the B210 SDR decoder for the current acquisition prototype; monitor-mode Wi-Fi remains an alternative/reference.
decisions.rationale: Latest user chose the SDR route and supplied connected hardware and a phone hotspot.

decisions.decision: Use the existing Radioconda UHD 4.8 environment for the B210.
decisions.rationale: Avoid a parallel, older system UHD 4.1 stack and resulting library, image, and path mismatches.
Decode frames transiently to identify beacons; retain only metadata, never raw user payloads/IQ or packet files. No RF transmission, interference or unsupported attribution.

decisions.decision: Add RSSI trilateration as a calibrated experimental baseline alongside bearings, with known AP coordinates kept out of the estimator.
decisions.rationale: Implement the user sketches and compare methods without treating RSSI as an inherently dependable range sensor.

decisions.decision: Identify APs by BSSID and frequency, join GPS/captures explicitly by station ID, and estimate only with sufficient usable station geometry.
decisions.rationale: SSID names can repeat and APs are not heard at every station; missing detections must not become invented distance readings.

decisions.decision: Proceed with the B210 SDR Wi-Fi decoder path using the existing Radioconda packages.
decisions.rationale: User said to proceed with gr-ieee802-11. GNU Radio 3.10.12, ieee802_11, foo and UHD 4.8 are already installed and import successfully; no dependency clone/build is needed to begin.

decisions.decision: Record per-frame LS training power in dBFS; leave rssi_dbm empty without measured matching calibration.
decisions.rationale: Relative signal power, SNR and absolute antenna power are different quantities. Current demo-1 requires dBm; explicit relative-power model support is future work.
